title: Gleam Is Now on Tangled
summary: Gleam, a type-safe functional programming language that compiles to Erlang/OTP and JavaScript, is now available on the Tangled documentation platform. This integration provides better accessibility and learning resources for developers interested in the Gleam ecosystem.
problem_solved: Makes the Gleam programming language more accessible to developers by providing centralized documentation and learning resources on the Tangled platform.
why_valuable: Gleam's combination of type safety, functional programming paradigms, and cross-compilation to both BEAM and JavaScript makes it valuable for developers building reliable web and backend systems, and this integration helps onboard new users.
